gen-gf-offside-gf-carrois-gothic: Wide-spaced and unclosed, Offside shouts. Carrois Gothic, with its tall middle band and generous c, simply gets on with being readable underneath it.
gen-gf-offside-gf-gidole: Offside spreads its letters wide, with curves that never quite close. Gidole follows in sans form, its terminals held apart like scissor blades, so the loud top line gets a tidy, neon-tube counterpart.
gen-gf-offside-gf-hind-siliguri: Loud, gapped and widely spaced: that is Offside. Hind Siliguri comes in with rounds that gap like a cracked bangle and a flat gray hum of line weight, giving the heading a friendly echo.
gen-gf-offside-gf-huninn: Commanding is Offside's mood, though with no thick-thin shifts it never raises its voice. Huninn, a sans-serif with lowercase rising close to cap height and crossbars as fat as its stems, supplies the sturdiest quality of the pair: a firm, readable footing.
gen-gf-offside-gf-inter-tight: Offside's curves refuse to close, and its wide tracking gives every line a stretched, deliberate stride. Inter Tight, built from lines like bent rope and short ascenders, packs a long passage into a compact, steady texture.
gen-gf-offside-gf-karla: Wide, tube-like letters up top, then something stockier below. Offside holds a constant line while Karla, a sans-serif with a gaping c and tall middle band, adds the sturdy bulk.
gen-gf-offside-gf-mochiy-pop-p-one: Mochiy Pop P One lays out a wide stretch of blank space between each sizable lowercase letter. Give it a little extra size.
gen-gf-offside-gf-mozilla-headline: Stretched, unclosed and loud, the heading takes charge. Mozilla Headline's big-bodied lowercase and splayed c terminal make a longer read feel friendly.
gen-gf-offside-gf-nata-sans: Offside lets its curves refuse to close and spreads its letters wide, giving the top line a quiet, level command. Nata Sans matches it with open-mouthed curves and a technical-pen steadiness.
gen-gf-offside-gf-nobile: A wire-bent sign look, widely tracked and constant in thickness: that is Offside. Nobile follows with a minimal gap between lowercase and caps and open mouths like unjoined chalk arcs, giving the loud heading a composed partner.
